findings_and_qualified_questions.first_failed_contract: If advance_towards is intended never to cross a positive target when the delta is large enough, intermediate binary32 cancellation can produce a value below that target.
findings_and_qualified_questions.mathematical_witness: For valid finite nonnegative self=1 metre, target=2^-30 metres, and maximum_delta=1 metre, exact binary32 round-to-nearest gives round_f32(2^-30 − 1) = −1 because the difference is much less than half the spacing below 1. The clamp retains −1; adding it to 1 yields 0, which is accepted by from_arithmetic and lies below the positive target. Each operand is an exactly representable f32. This is mathematical source reasoning, not product execution or a fixture.
